title: Canary harness for toolcall regressions on config/model changes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a continuous canary/eval harness that detects regressions in tool/function calling across configuration and model changes. The harness will run on every candidate model build and on relevant config deltas (batching, kv-cache, kernel flags, tool routing rules). Goals: 1) Measure tool selection accuracy vs. a golden label set, 2) Validate argument schemas and sanitization rules, 3) Surface regressions tied to model/config diffs with actionable diffs and lightweight counterfactuals, 4) Trigger alerts and open a triage runbook when quality drops exceed thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Automated canary runs execute for every model build and for config changes merged to main
Selection accuracy metric (top-K match) computed and compared to baseline; regression flag if delta > 3 percentage points
Argument validation coverage reported and false-positive rate measured; regression flag if invalid-arg rate increases by >2%
Datadog dashboard with per-run deltas, time series, and per-rule breakdown is created (link in artifacts)
PR pipeline will block merges to runtime when canary fails with P0-level regressions (configurable override with audit)
Runbook created and PagerDuty integration for critical regressions
comments: 2025-11-05 Aisha Patel: Created ticket. Scope drafted with product and evals. Proposed thresholds: selection delta > 3pp, arg-invalid delta >2pp. Asked infra for canary runner quota.
